metrics.profile_summary: Seasoned marketing professional with 12 years of experience across FMCG and B2B sectors. Expert in data-driven brand strategies, integrated digital campaigns, and market entry, with a proven track record of driving measurable growth and leading marketing functions.

education.institution: Indus Valley School of Art and Architecture (IVS), Karachi

experience.description: Manages yearly brand plans, budgets, and ROI optimization. Leads product innovation and digital strategies to drive website traffic and conversions.
Executed integrated ATL, BTL, and digital campaigns. Managed creative and PR agencies to increase customer loyalty and online sales.
Oversaw comprehensive brand strategy, P&L analysis, and digital transformation. Led international expansion into the UAE and managed organic/paid Meta and Google Ads.
Developed B2B/B2C communication tools and digital strategies, resulting in a 40% increase in lead generation.
Led corporate communication for office furniture, focusing on strategic partnerships and annual brand planning.
Developed multi-channel brand plans and activation strategies for top-tier clients like Engro Foods and GSK.
Conducted in-store activations and merchandising for ASDA to boost brand awareness and sales.
Managed BTL campaigns and operational planning for Unilever and Lakson Tobacco brands.

strengths: Extensive 12-year experience exceeding the 5-7 year requirement
Proven leadership as Head of Marketing and Brand Manager
Certified in GA4 and Google Ads
Expertise in both B2B and B2C integrated campaigns
weaknesses: Potentially overqualified for a mid-level Marketing Manager role
evaluation.summary: The candidate is an exceptional match, possessing all must-have technical skills (GA4, Ad platforms) and significantly exceeding the experience and education requirements. His history of managing budgets, teams, and agencies aligns perfectly with the role's responsibilities.
